label: Off-world contingent support and late support controls for the world scope of J1
term: off-world contingent support and late support controls
definition: Two finite interpretations over worlds false and true with universal access and three concrete candidates t0, t1, t2; t0 and t1 exist at both worlds, t2 only at true; no generic causes. offWorldContingent: at false t0 supports t1, at true t2 supports t1. lateSupport: at false t0 supports t1, at true t2 supports t0. Both are evaluated at the selected world false.
note: Analyst control models for the NecessarySupportActualScope batch; mathematical interpretations of the stated primitives, not claims of metaphysical possibility. Concrete is uniformly designated; the concrete/abstract line is not tested.
